definitions.explanation: Refers to the current time or moment.
Can indicate something that just happened or is about to happen.

examples.japanese: {今|いま}⟦{何時|なんじ}→何時：00973_nanji⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。

examples.english: I'm coming now. / I'll be right there.

examples.japanese: {今|いま}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{忙|いそが}しい→忙しい：00591_isogashii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{今|いま}⟦{帰|かえ}って→帰る：00508_kaeru⟧⟦きた→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{今|いま}⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧⟦ばかり→ばかり：02006_bakari⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
{今|いま}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{出|で}かけます→出かける：00833_dekakeru⟧。

examples.english: Do you like your current job?

examples.japanese: {今|いま}⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧⟦{来|き}て→来る：00254_kuru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。⟦{大変|たいへん}→大変：00594_taihen⟧なこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ありました→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Please come right away. Something terrible happened.

notes: {今|いま} is one of the most common time expressions in Japanese. It appears in many compound words: ⟦{今日|きょう}→今日：00496_kyou⟧ (today), ⟦{今週|こんしゅう}→今週：00721_konshuu⟧ (this week), ⟦{今月|こんげつ}→今月：00720_kongetsu⟧ (this month), ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧ (this year). When someone calls you, responding {今|いま}{行|い}きます means you'll be there shortly.
